title: Aws Security Advisories - 2026-11-11
description:
Merged 3 aws security advisories published on 2026-11-11. Original advisory IDs: 2026-179-aws, 2026-180-aws, 2026-181-aws

Titles:
- CVE-2026-100307 - Missing authorization on the external management API in mcp-gateway-registry enables privilege escalation to registry administrator
- CVE-2026-125926 - Server-side request forgery in the server registration and update API in mcp-gateway-registry
- CVE-2026-127119 - Unverified ownership of the default EMR cluster log location in AWS SDK for pandas
